items.text: 本周唯一不想改第三版的东西：刚出炉的鸡块。周四谁来陪我做一次盲测？
items.english: The only thing I don't want a third revision of this week: freshly fried nuggets. Who's up for a blind taste test this Thursday?

items.text: 我把周四的日历空了一格，留给一份炸鸡和一个不聊工作的朋友。你有空吗？
items.english: I left a slot open on Thursday for fried chicken and a friend who won't talk about work. Are you free?

items.text: 自动回复：人暂时离线，正在参加疯狂星期四咔嚓研讨会。有事请等我把这一口咽下去。
items.english: Auto-reply: I'm away at a Crazy Thursday seminar on all things crunchy. Please wait until I've swallowed this bite.

items.text: 手机开了专注模式，只允许两种通知：炸鸡到了，以及有人问我周四要不要一起吃。
items.english: My phone is in Focus mode. Only two notifications get through: the fried chicken is here, and someone wants to grab some with me on Thursday.

items.text: 下午三点，脑子比文档还空。提议把下一场会改成疯狂星期四试吃会，议程只有一项：趁热。
items.english: It's three in the afternoon and my mind is blanker than the document. Let's make the next meeting a Crazy Thursday tasting. One item on the agenda: eat it hot.

items.text: 我本来只想尝一口。后来发现，一口的定义可以随着鸡块的数量灵活调整。
items.english: I was only going to have one bite. Turns out the definition of one bite can expand with the number of nuggets.

items.text: 朋友说开吃前先拍照。我的炸鸡已经少了一块，照片请按实物为准。
items.english: My friend said to take a picture before we ate. One piece is already missing. Please judge the photo against what's left on the plate.

items.text: 周四立项：去吃炸鸡。预算待议，执行人两名，验收标准是回家路上还想打包一份。
items.english: Thursday project: go get fried chicken. Budget pending, two people required. It passes review if we still want an order to take home.

items.text: 我说下班走路回家。绕到肯德基那一段，也算步数。
items.english: I said I'd walk home after work. The detour to KFC still counts toward my steps.

items.text: 天气预报说有风。我只关心取到炸鸡以后，回家这段路能不能顺风。
items.english: The forecast says it'll be windy. All I care about is getting a tailwind on the way home with the fried chicken.

items.text: 消息可以晚点回，炸鸡凉了却不会自己变脆。周四见面聊吧，我负责带纸巾。
items.english: Messages can wait. Cold fried chicken won't crisp itself back up. Let's catch up on Thursday. I'll bring napkins.

items.text: 请问谁动了我的鸡块？监控不用查了，是我。我刚才又动了一块。
items.english: Who took one of my nuggets? No need to check the cameras. It was me, and I just took another.

items.text: 周四下班的路线已经优化：先关电脑，再去买炸鸡，中间不经过任何会议室。
items.english: I've optimized my Thursday commute: shut the laptop, go get fried chicken, and pass through zero meeting rooms.

items.text: 收到一条紧急需求：有炸鸡，需要两个人尽快吃掉。其他需求明天排期。
items.english: Urgent request received: fried chicken needs two people to eat it as soon as possible. Everything else goes on tomorrow's schedule.

items.text: 给周四配个音：打开袋子是沙沙，第一口是咔嚓，朋友说不吃时是我偷偷往自己这边挪盘子。
items.english: Thursday's soundtrack: a paper bag rustling, the first bite crunching, and my plate sliding closer when my friend says they're not hungry.

items.text: 导航问我是否避开拥堵。我选了避开加班，途经一家有炸鸡的店。
items.english: The map asked if I wanted to avoid traffic. I'd rather avoid overtime and make a stop for fried chicken.

items.text: 友情提醒：周四最有效的团建，是把手机扣在桌上，再把炸鸡放在中间。
items.english: Friendly reminder: the best Thursday team-building activity is putting your phones face down and sharing fried chicken.

items.text: 我认真记录了今天的饮食：早餐正常，午餐正常，晚餐出现了一群特别香的例外。
items.english: I logged today's meals carefully. Breakfast was normal. Lunch was normal. Dinner featured a whole group of delicious exceptions.

items.text: 今天没有大事值得庆祝。正好，给那些顺利过去的小事买一份炸鸡。
items.english: Nothing big to celebrate today. Perfect. I'll get fried chicken for all the little things that went right.

items.text: 盘里剩最后一块时，两个人都说你吃吧。真正的友谊，在下一秒两只手伸向同一个地方。
items.english: With one piece left, we both said, 'You have it.' Real friendship is what happens the next second, when both hands reach for it.

items.text: 想发一个热闹的疯狂星期四段子，写了三版。最后决定把段子留在草稿箱，把炸鸡带到你楼下。
items.english: I wrote three versions of a Crazy Thursday joke. In the end I left the joke in drafts and brought the fried chicken to your building.

items.text: 周四的线上方案写不出来，那就执行线下方案：路口见，点餐，聊点别的。
items.english: The online plan isn't coming together this Thursday. Let's try the offline plan: meet at the corner, order food, and talk about something else.

items.text: 纸袋拎在手里还热着。突然觉得，今天的路也没那么长。疯狂星期四，下班就出发。
items.english: The paper bag is still warm in my hand. Suddenly the walk doesn't feel so long. Crazy Thursday starts right after work.

items.text: 对不起，刚才那段语音只有咔嚓声。翻译一下：炸鸡不错，你也来一块。
items.english: Sorry that voice note was all crunching. Translation: the fried chicken is good. Come have a piece.

items.text: 我家的电饭煲今天请假，理由写的是周四。锅盖已经签字了，我只能去吃炸鸡。
items.english: My rice cooker requested the day off because it’s Thursday. The lid signed off, so I’m going out for fried chicken.

items.text: 刚学会一招省钱法。路过炸鸡店时走快点，跑到下一条街再绕回来，就当额外消耗了两口。
items.english: I learned a money-saving trick. Walk briskly past the chicken shop, then circle back from the next block. At least you’ve earned two bites.

items.text: 同事问我下午怎么突然有精神了。我说楼下炸鸡店开始备餐，我的鼻子提前打卡了。
items.english: A coworker asked why I suddenly perked up this afternoon. The chicken shop downstairs started cooking, and my nose clocked in early.

items.text: 订会议室的时候手滑选成了靠门口的位子，正好方便我接周四的外卖。看来手比我有职业规划。
items.english: I accidentally booked the seat by the door. Perfect for picking up my Thursday delivery. My hand has a better career plan than I do.

items.text: 周四最有默契的对话是“吃吗”和“在楼下了”。至于吃什么，袋子隔着门都交代清楚了。
items.english: The most in-sync Thursday exchange is “Want some?” followed by “I’m downstairs.” The bag smells good enough to answer what’s inside.

items.text: 今天买炸鸡可以坐公交回家，但我决定步行。被邻居闻到的时间能长一点，我这份晚餐就不算白等。
items.english: I could take the bus home with my fried chicken, but I’m walking. The longer the neighbors smell it, the more worthwhile the wait feels.

items.text: 我跟周四谈了条件，白天的会一个不少开，晚上的鸡腿也一个不能少。
items.english: I struck a deal with Thursday. I’ll attend every meeting by day, and every drumstick had better show up by night.

items.text: 今天试着把炸鸡放到盘子里再吃。发现盘子还没摆好，盒子已经完成了一半的减重。
items.english: I tried plating my fried chicken today. Before the plates were even ready, the box had already lost half its weight.

items.text: 我的购物清单只有“洗衣液”。去拿洗衣液的路上我买了炸鸡，至少手上有两袋，走路比较平衡。
items.english: My shopping list only said “laundry detergent.” I bought fried chicken on the way. At least carrying two bags keeps me balanced.

items.text: 周四的工作群先问有没有空，再问能不能接活。饭搭子只问有没有空，再补一句“我多点了一份”。
items.english: The work chat asks whether I’m free, then hands me a task. My Thursday food buddy asks the same question and adds, “I ordered extra.”

items.text: 天冷到手机快没电，我把它揣进口袋，把炸鸡拎在手上。人到关键时刻确实会分清主次。
items.english: It was so cold my phone nearly died. I put it in my pocket and kept the fried chicken in my hand. A crisis really clarifies your priorities.

items.text: 我爸打电话问我会不会做饭。我说周四会，能准确判断哪袋炸鸡要先打开，哪袋留给他。
items.english: Dad called to ask if I could cook. On Thursdays I can, I told him. I know exactly which chicken bag to open first and which to save for him.

items.text: 今天办公室丢了一支笔，大家都找不到。丢的那块炸鸡倒是破案很快，证据在我手指上。
items.english: A pen went missing at the office today and no one found it. The missing piece of chicken was solved much faster. The evidence was on my fingers.

items.text: 周四出门前我特意带了伞。外卖袋怕淋，至于我，能进店时顺便擦干。
items.english: I took an umbrella on Thursday. The takeout bag can’t get wet. I can dry off once I’m inside.

items.text: 我给鸡腿让出了桌上最稳的位置。那是上周放显示器的地方，周四有周四的人事安排。
items.english: I gave my drumstick the steadiest spot on the desk. Last week it belonged to my monitor. Thursday makes its own staffing decisions.

items.text: 本来想给炸鸡拍一段拆盒视频，按完录制才发现镜头对着我。倒也拍到了周四最真诚的笑容。
items.english: I meant to film a fried chicken unboxing but had the camera facing me. At least I caught Thursday’s most genuine smile.

items.text: 朋友说请我吃炸鸡，我说不必客气。等他听懂我的意思是不用替我挑小的那块，我已经拿到了。
items.english: A friend offered me chicken, so I told him not to stand on ceremony. By the time he realized I meant “don’t pick out a small piece for me,” I had the big one.

items.text: 周四开冰箱看到半颗生菜，我决定点炸鸡。等炸鸡到了再想起来，那半颗生菜可以当今天的摆盘顾问。
items.english: I opened the fridge on Thursday, saw half a head of lettuce, and ordered fried chicken. When it arrived, I remembered the lettuce could help with presentation.

items.text: 今天穿白衣服吃炸鸡，吃完一看，衣服上干干净净。原来刚才最大的油点落在开会笔记上了。
items.english: I wore white to eat fried chicken and came away spotless. Turns out the biggest grease spot landed on my meeting notes.

items.text: 家里秤电池没电了，谁都没急着换。周四炸鸡到了，我妈突然想知道我切走的那块到底有多大。
items.english: The kitchen scale died and nobody rushed to replace the batteries. Then Thursday chicken arrived, and Mom suddenly wanted to weigh the piece I took.

items.text: 我跟朋友约好到店再点。见面时两个人都拎着炸鸡，先各自解释两句，再把两盒摆在一起。
items.english: A friend and I agreed to order when we got there. We both showed up carrying chicken, explained ourselves for a minute, and put the two boxes together.

items.text: 准备开吃的时候门铃响了，我以为是第二份。开门是物业，礼貌退回去重新期待了一下。
items.english: The doorbell rang just as I was about to eat. I thought it was a second order. It was the building manager, so I politely went back to hoping.

items.text: 我把周四晚上的事项填成“回家看书”。回家确实翻了两页，第一页是点单记录，第二页是复购记录。
items.english: I put “read at home” on my Thursday calendar. I did turn two pages: first my order history, then the reorder screen.

items.text: 今天有人问我最近在练什么。我练的是听电梯到几楼，判断炸鸡还差几个拐弯。
items.english: Someone asked what I’ve been practicing lately. Listening to the elevator, so I know how many turns my fried chicken still has to make.

items.text: 我本来准备先冲澡再吃。炸鸡袋一开，沐浴露从“马上用”调到了“饭后再说”。
items.english: I was going to shower before dinner. Once the chicken bag opened, the shower gel went from “right now” to “after dinner.”

items.text: 我给朋友留了最后一块鸡翅，发消息说趁热。朋友没到，我决定先替他遵守时间要求。
items.english: I saved the last wing for a friend and texted him to eat it while it was hot. He was late, so I met the deadline on his behalf.

items.text: 周四我把饭盒带来了。午休时它装的是米饭，下班它装的是我努力留住的第二只鸡腿。
items.english: I brought a lunchbox on Thursday. It held rice at lunch and the second drumstick I fought to save on the way home.

items.text: 早上刚给扫地机器人换了滤网，晚上想让它做点轻活。结果周四的炸鸡太脆，它第一次干到电量报警。
items.english: I gave the robot vacuum a new filter and planned to give it an easy evening. Thursday chicken was so crispy it worked until the battery alarm went off.

items.text: 小区群说楼道有香味，问谁家做饭。我点开聊天准备潜水，纸袋偏偏在这时候响了一声。
items.english: The building chat asked who was cooking because the hallway smelled so good. I was about to stay quiet when the paper bag crinkled.

items.text: 今天嘴上说“买给大家的”。袋子在我桌上响了两次，第二次是我重新数还有多少能给大家。
items.english: I said I bought it for everyone. The bag rustled twice at my desk. The second time I was checking what was still available to everyone.

items.text: 开门那一刻我才想起今天没带钥匙。还好朋友在屋里，鸡腿在我手里，我们各自掌握了一半的筹码。
items.english: At the door I remembered I’d left my keys inside. My friend had the door, I had the drumsticks, and we each held half the leverage.

items.text: 周四训练计划写了三组推举。我把炸鸡举起来找光、举起来避开猫、举起来吃掉，三组齐了。
items.english: Thursday’s plan called for three sets of lifts. I lifted the chicken into the light, lifted it away from the cat, then lifted it to my mouth. Three sets done.

items.text: 做表做到所有数字都对不上，只有盒里四块炸鸡算得明白。吃掉一块以后，三块，头一回顺利对账。
items.english: None of the numbers in my spreadsheet matched. The four pieces in the chicken box did. I ate one, counted three, and finally reconciled something.

items.text: 想发一张周四的晚餐照，手机提示存储空间不足。我删了两张空白截图，没忍心删去年那张鸡腿。
items.english: I wanted a Thursday dinner photo, but my phone was full. I deleted two blank screenshots and couldn’t bring myself to delete last year’s drumstick.

items.text: 去拿炸鸡的时候我换了双安静的鞋，想低调回来。谁知纸袋比鞋子诚实，香味大到邻居认出了是哪家的。
items.english: I wore quiet shoes to collect my chicken and tried to slip back unnoticed. The smell was loud enough for my neighbor to name the shop.

items.text: 最近学做家常菜，第一课是别给热菜盖太久盖子。周四炸鸡到手，我用最快的速度实践了这一课。
items.english: I’m learning to cook at home. Lesson one was not to leave hot food covered too long. I practiced it as fast as possible when Thursday chicken arrived.

items.text: 我问朋友这周哪天有空。他说周四下午给我发定位。果然是个行动派，定位从店门口发来的。
items.english: I asked which day my friend was free. He said he’d send a pin Thursday afternoon. A man of action: he sent it from the chicken shop door.

items.text: 给自己买的炸鸡被爸妈看见了。我说只尝一点，后来他们尝得很有分寸，我也很有分寸地又点了一盒。
items.english: My parents spotted the chicken I bought for myself. I said they could have a taste. They took a very modest amount, and I very modestly ordered another box.

items.text: 我家电视遥控器每周四准点失踪。前两次在沙发缝，这次在桌上，压着最后一个鸡块的纸袋。
items.english: The TV remote disappears like clockwork on Thursdays. Twice it was in the couch. This time it was on the table, weighing down the bag with the last nugget.

items.text: 今天加班最有效的一句话是“下楼拿炸鸡”。四个人同时合上电脑，连平时最爱问截止时间的人都没追问。
items.english: The most effective line at overtime today was “Let’s go get chicken.” Four laptops snapped shut, and even the deadline guy didn’t ask when.

items.text: 我的保温杯今天装的是白开水，负责让炸鸡看上去有一位朴素的同事。
items.english: My flask has plain water in it today. Its job is to give my fried chicken a sensible coworker.

items.text: 周四的炸鸡外卖让我学会了断舍离。袋子、盒子、纸巾全都能放下，最后那只鸡翅先留一留。
items.english: Thursday delivery taught me to let go. The bag, the box, the napkins can all go. That last wing can stay a little longer.

items.text: 和朋友说好分一半，他负责分，我负责选。他迟疑了三秒，主动把厨房秤搬了出来。
items.english: A friend and I agreed to split the chicken. He’d divide it, I’d choose a half. After a three-second pause, he brought out the kitchen scale.

items.text: 邻桌小朋友吃炸鸡先吹三下，我学了一下。第二下还没吹完，筷子已经自己作了决定。
items.english: A kid at the next table blew on his chicken three times first. I tried it. My chopsticks made an executive decision before the second breath was over.

items.text: 今天做了电子账单归类，杂项全挪回原科目。周四的炸鸡单独留一类，毕竟它每周都来开会。
items.english: I organized my expenses today and filed the miscellaneous ones properly. Thursday chicken gets its own category. It shows up for the meeting every week.

items.text: 饭桌上就剩一块鸡翅，大家商量要不要各切一半。奶奶听了说别麻烦，一抬手替全家省下了这场会。
items.english: One wing was left and we were discussing cutting it in half. Grandma said not to bother and spared us the meeting in one move.

items.text: 我给闹钟取了个名字叫“别忘了周四”。响的时候午睡刚开始，但身体比脑子更懂这五个字。
items.english: I named my alarm “Don’t forget Thursday.” It went off just as I drifted into a nap, but my body understood the message before my brain did.

items.text: 带着一盒鸡腿坐了三站地铁。我以为没人注意，直到下车时旁边的人看了一眼我，又看了一眼手里的三明治。
items.english: I rode three stops with a box of drumsticks. I thought nobody noticed until a passenger looked at me, then down at his sandwich.

items.text: 今天在公园练发声，刚准备朗读就打开了炸鸡。路过的人全听见了，倒没用到我的嗓子。
items.english: I went to the park to practice speaking out loud and opened my chicken first. Everyone walking past heard it. My voice didn’t have to do a thing.

items.text: 朋友夸我最近学会分享了。我说得看场合，周四分享定位特别大方，分享鸡块得重新评估。
items.english: A friend said I’d gotten better at sharing. Depends what it is, I told him. On Thursdays I’ll share the location freely. The nuggets need a fresh assessment.

items.text: 回家时满手东西，我把信件夹在胳膊下，钥匙叼在嘴里，只有炸鸡享受了双手托运。
items.english: I came home with my hands full. Mail under an arm, keys between my teeth, and the fried chicken got both hands.

items.text: 拍下刚才的空盒，准备发给催我减负的同事。今天桌上的东西确实少了，效果非常直观。
items.english: I took a picture of the empty box for the coworker who keeps telling me to lighten my load. The desk really is less cluttered. The results speak for themselves.

items.text: 刚收到一条提醒，让我评价配送体验。我盯着空盒子看了半天，才想起来人家问的是送得快不快。
items.english: I got a reminder to rate the delivery. I stared at the empty box for a while before remembering they wanted to know how fast it arrived.

items.text: 上一次在超市排队这么专注，是怕人插队。这一次是提着炸鸡，怕离烤面包柜太近后两边都想买。
items.english: The last time I focused this hard in a supermarket line, I was watching for queue jumpers. This time I’m holding chicken and trying not to buy everything at the bakery counter too.

items.text: 本来想用一杯茶给周四收尾。茶还没泡，先听见桌上有人敲了敲炸鸡盒，原来是我自己的手。
items.english: I planned to end Thursday with a cup of tea. Before I brewed it, someone tapped the chicken box. It turned out to be my own hand.

items.text: 有人在朋友圈晒自律作息。我也晒一个，炸鸡出锅后八分钟必须到桌上，超过九分钟我就坐立不安。
items.english: Someone posted their disciplined routine. Here’s mine: chicken has to reach the table within eight minutes of leaving the fryer. At nine I start pacing.

items.text: 邻居问我买这么多纸巾做什么。我说准备过周四。她点点头，掏出一瓶辣椒粉说自己也有准备。
items.english: My neighbor asked why I’d bought so many napkins. I said I was getting ready for Thursday. She nodded and pulled out a jar of chili powder.

items.text: 有人问我周四为什么总带口袋多的外套。我说手机钥匙随便塞，留两只手把炸鸡端平比较重要。
items.english: Someone asked why I always wear a jacket with lots of pockets on Thursdays. The phone and keys can go anywhere. I need both hands to keep the chicken level.

items.text: 我问朋友想吃哪块，他说“你先挑”。从此我把他列进了周四最值得见的名单。
items.english: I asked which piece my friend wanted. He said, “You pick first.” He’s been on my Thursday shortlist ever since.

items.text: 外卖小哥打电话说放门口了，我没急着去拿。主要是我已经站在门外，电话可以慢慢挂。
items.english: The courier called to say it was at the door. I didn’t rush to get it. I was already standing outside, so we could take our time hanging up.

items.text: 周四拆盒前记得把袖子挽起来。今天袖口上的酱告诉我，生活里的经验总要交一点学费。
items.english: Roll up your sleeves before opening the chicken on Thursday. The sauce on my cuff says life’s little lessons do charge tuition.

items.text: 风太大了，手里的发票飞出去两米。我先把炸鸡交给朋友，再追发票，分工非常明确。
items.english: The wind sent my receipt two meters down the street. I handed the chicken to a friend and went after it. Clear division of labor.

items.text: 今天带饭搭子第一次来，特意让他坐靠窗的位置。这样灯光好，能看清我留给他的那块到底小不小。
items.english: I took my food buddy here for the first time and gave him the window seat. Good light, so he could see exactly how small the piece I left him was.

items.text: 周四的箱子有一种特殊的物理现象，刚掀盖时内容很多，等我找到遥控器回来，空间突然就大了。
items.english: Thursday boxes exhibit an odd bit of physics. They’re full when you open them, but by the time I find the remote, there’s suddenly much more space.

items.text: 我认真写了一个晚饭备选清单。第二项还没写完，第一项炸鸡已经显示正在配送。
items.english: I sat down to make a proper list of dinner options. Before I finished the second item, option one was already out for delivery.

items.text: 到门口才发现店里排队，我准备回家。刚转身听见后面有人说“那份好了”，于是脚下十分自然地停了。
items.english: I saw the line at the shop and decided to go home. Then I heard “that order’s ready” behind me, and my feet naturally came to a stop.

items.text: 原来工作日也能像放假。只要周四那份炸鸡到得够准时，我可以心无旁骛地休息十五分钟。
items.english: A weekday can feel like a holiday. If the Thursday chicken arrives on time, I can take fifteen minutes completely off.

items.text: 这周把厨房桌面擦得特别干净，朋友以为我开始爱做饭了。其实是怕炸鸡盒放下时沾上水。
items.english: I wiped the kitchen table spotless this week and my friends thought I’d taken up cooking. I just didn’t want the chicken box sitting in a puddle.

items.text: 说好今晚只买一份，临出门爸问他那份呢。我说家庭预算向来有临时增补的机制。
items.english: I said we’d buy just one order tonight. As I headed out, Dad asked where his was. I told him the household budget allows for emergency additions.

items.text: 周四最怕看到的消息是“帮我留一口”。“一口”有多大说不准，留到什么时候也没写清。
items.english: The scariest Thursday text is “Save me a bite.” There’s no specification for how big a bite is, or how long I’m supposed to save it.

items.text: 我想在家静坐十分钟，听见炸鸡到了还是下楼了。至少从开门到开盒，脑子里真的没有杂念。
items.english: I tried to sit quietly for ten minutes and went downstairs as soon as the chicken arrived. At least my mind was clear from door to box.

items.text: 朋友开车来接我去买炸鸡，说副驾驶别掉渣。回程我坐后排，一边吃一边认真遵守了他的要求。
items.english: A friend drove me to get chicken and told me not to drop crumbs in the front seat. I ate in the back on the way home and followed his instructions to the letter.

items.text: 走回家只要七分钟，我今天用了十二分钟。途中路过两张长椅，每张都认真考虑了要不要提前开吃。
items.english: It takes seven minutes to walk home. Today it took twelve. I passed two benches and seriously considered starting dinner at both.

items.text: 刚跟家里说不用等我吃饭，妹妹马上问能不能等等她。她听出来我说这话的时候纸袋有动静。
items.english: I told my family not to wait up for dinner. My sister immediately asked if I could wait for her. She heard the paper bag in the background.

items.text: 拿到炸鸡才发现忘了加餐具。我对着它们看了两秒，发现这可能是今天唯一一个不用开会解决的问题。
items.english: I got my chicken and realized I’d forgotten the utensils. After looking at it for two seconds, I found the only problem today that didn’t need a meeting.

items.text: 今天吃完没有立刻洗碗，先把朋友送到门口。约好下周四他带炸鸡，我负责把盘子早一点找出来。
items.english: I didn’t go straight to the dishes after dinner. I walked my friend to the door. Next Thursday he’ll bring the chicken, and I’ll find the plates a little earlier.
